paragraphs.text: Kwende is a human knight from Femeref on Dominaria . He is descended from the Zhalfirin general Mageta the Lion whom he idolized.

Kwende is descended from followers of the renowned Zhalfirin general Mageta the Lion . Though Mageta was phased out of time with the rest of Zhalfir , Kwende's ancestors were outside Zhalfir when Teferi worked his magic, and they settled in Femeref like many other dispossessed Zhalfirins . Kwende idolizes the famous general, who is known for turning the tide in a war against Keldon invaders some 350 years ago. He strives to live a life worthy of songs that might be sung alongside Mageta's deeds.
Kwende wields a pair of crystalline blades made by minotaurs of the Talruum Mountains , which have vanished along with Zhalfir .
He attempted to murder Teferi , shortly after the Mending , as revenge for the phasing of Zhalfir.
Kwende fought in defense of Dominaria during the New Phyrexian Invasion .
